findings.summary: TCPA consent missing FCC 2024 one-to-one mechanics: no seller+brokerage legal name inside consent string, no ATDS/prerecorded-voice disclosure, no page-snapshot retention policy alongside consent_text+timestamp.

Florida brokerage-relationship disclosure under F.S. §475.278 / FREC Rule 61J2-10.033 (Transaction Broker Notice family) is not named; LPT question is framed too generically to elicit the statutory answer.

NAR Membership Marks Manual specifics missed: adjacency-punctuation rule (comma between name and REALTOR®), plural/possessive handling, domain-name usage; local board reference is stale (RAGFL absorbed into BPSR in 2020).

EHO question is not bounded to HUD spec: no ask about relative-size/prominence vs other logos, no choice between EHO logotype vs slogan vs full statement, and county-level Fair Housing classes (Broward source-of-income) are not in scope.

SEF MLS ask narrows to disclaimer text; misses last-updated timestamp, per-listing broker attribution, prohibited-modifications, co-mingling, and opt-out obligations — and the iframe vs direct-feed scope boundary.
Consent string references SMS ('Reply STOP') but form may capture email-only; STOP/HELP keyword handling and sms_opt_out_at audit fields are absent from §3 custom fields and §8 audit log.

PDF disclaimer recommendation is generic; FL-specific items missing — flood/wind/Citizens insurance currency date, F.S. §718.503/§720.401 condo-HOA disclosure, Johnson v Davis duty-to-disclose for prior storm damage.
DBPR verification step records only active y/n; should record employing broker linkage + expiration date and schedule a renewal-cadence audit (24-month FL renewal).

audit-stale-terms Fair Housing list is federal-proxy-only; missing source-of-income proxies (Broward), disability proxies ('walk-up', 'must climb stairs'), HOPA 55+ wording rules, national-origin proxies.
REALTOR® mark gated on NAR confirmation but no fallback rendering specified if confirmation is not in hand at launch — risks copy-paste scramble at cutover.

disposition: Findings routed to packet addenda; none rise to `critical`, so no phase:complete block per Algorithm v6.4.0 Rule 2a verdict table. Two `high` findings (CATO-01, CATO-02) lift to TOP of Cycle 24-LEGAL-CLOSURE.
verdict_action: Cycle 22 commits packet addenda. Cycle 24 ships findings into source/text.
